(define (domain jackofalltrades_instance)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types obj)

  (:predicates
    (hand ?x - obj)
    (cats ?x - obj)
    (texture ?x - obj)
    (sneeze ?x - obj)
    (spring ?x - obj)

    (collect ?x - obj ?y - obj)
  )

  (:action paltry
    :parameters (?x - obj ?y - obj ?z - obj)
    :precondition (and
      (hand ?x)
      (cats ?y)
      (texture ?z)
      (vase ?x ?y)
      (next ?y ?z)
    )

      (next ?x ?z)

    )
  )

      (texture ?z)
      (next ?x ?z)
      (next ?y ?z)
    )
    :effect (and
      (vase ?x ?y)
      (not (next ?x ?z))
    )
  )

  (:action clip

      (texture ?z)

      (next ?x ?z)

      (not (next ?x ?z))
    )
  )

    )

    )
  )

      (next ?x ?z)
      (not (vase ?x ?y))
    )
  )

    )

    :effect (and

(define (domain jack_of_all_trades_instance)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types obj)

  (:predicates
    (hand ?x - obj)
    (cats ?x - obj)
    (sneeze ?x - obj)
    (texture ?x - obj)
    (spring ?x - obj)

    (next ?x - obj ?y - obj)

  )

    )
  )

    :effect (and

      (not (next ?h ?t))
    )

      (texture ?t)

    :effect (and

      (not (next ?h ?t))
    )
  )

(define (domain jack_of_all_trades_instance)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types obj)

  (:predicates
    (hand ?x - obj)
    (cats ?x - obj)
    (sneeze ?x - obj)
    (texture ?x - obj)
    (spring ?x - obj)
    (stupendous ?x - obj)
    (collect ?x - obj ?g - obj)
    (next ?x - obj ?y - obj)
    (vase ?x - obj ?y - obj)
  )

  (:action paltry
    :parameters (?h - obj ?c - obj ?t - obj)
    :precondition (and
      (hand ?h)
      (cats ?c)
      (texture ?t)
      (vase ?h ?c)
      (next ?c ?t)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?h ?t)
      (not (vase ?h ?c))
    )
  )

  (:action sip
    :parameters (?h - obj ?c - obj ?t - obj)
    :precondition (and
      (hand ?h)
      (cats ?c)
      (texture ?t)
      (next ?h ?t)
      (next ?c ?t)
    )
    :effect (and
      (vase ?h ?c)
      (not (next ?h ?t))
    )
  )

  (:action clip
    :parameters (?h - obj ?s - obj ?t - obj)
    :precondition (and
      (hand ?h)
      (sneeze ?s)
      (texture ?t)
      (next ?s ?t)
      (next ?h ?t)
    )
    :effect (and
      (vase ?h ?s)
      (not (next ?h ?t))
    )
  )

  (:action wretched
    :parameters (?s - obj ?from - obj ?to - obj ?g - obj)
    :precondition (and
      (sneeze ?s)
      (texture ?from)
      (texture ?to)
      (stupendous ?g)
      (next ?s ?from)
      (collect ?from ?g)
      (collect ?to ?g)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?s ?to)
      (not (next ?s ?from))
    )
  )

  (:action memory

    :precondition (and
      (cats ?c)
      (spring ?from)
      (spring ?to)
      (next ?c ?from)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?c ?to)
      (not (next ?c ?from))
    )
  )

      (sneeze ?s)
      (texture ?t)
      (next ?s ?t)
      (vase ?h ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?h ?t)
      (not (vase ?h ?s))
    )
  )

(define (domain jack_of_all_trades_instance)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)

  (:types
    object
    hand_obj cats_obj sneeze_obj texture_obj spring_obj stupendous_obj - object
  )

  (:predicates

    (vase ?h - hand_obj ?x - object)
    (collect ?t - texture_obj ?g - stupendous_obj)
  )

  (:action paltry
    :parameters (?h - hand_obj ?c - cats_obj ?t - texture_obj)
    :precondition (and
      (vase ?h ?c)
      (next ?c ?t)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?h ?t)
      (not (vase ?h ?c))
    )
  )

  (:action sip
    :parameters (?h - hand_obj ?c - cats_obj ?t - texture_obj)
    :precondition (and
      (next ?h ?t)
      (next ?c ?t)
    )
    :effect (and
      (vase ?h ?c)
      (not (next ?h ?t))
    )
  )

      (next ?s ?t)
      (next ?h ?t)
    )
    :effect (and
      (vase ?h ?s)
      (not (next ?h ?t))
    )
  )

      (next ?s ?t_from)
      (collect ?t_from ?g)
      (collect ?t_to ?g)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?s ?t_to)
      (not (next ?s ?t_from))
    )
  )

    :precondition (and
      (next ?c ?sp_from)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?c ?sp_to)
      (not (next ?c ?sp_from))
    )
  )

    :precondition (and
      (next ?s ?t)
      (vase ?h ?s)
    )
    :effect (and
      (next ?h ?t)
      (not (vase ?h ?s))
    )

(define (domain jack_of_all_trades_instance)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)

  (:types
    thing
  )

  (:predicates
    (hand ?x - thing)
    (cats ?x - thing)
    (sneeze ?x - thing)
    (texture ?x - thing)
    (spring ?x - thing)
    (stupendous ?x - thing)
    (collect ?x - thing ?y - thing)
    (next ?x - thing ?y - thing)
    (vase ?x - thing ?y - thing)
  )

  (:action paltry
    :parameters (?o0 - thing ?o1 - thing ?o2 - thing)
    :precondition (and
      (hand ?o0)
      (cats ?o1)
      (texture ?o2)
      (vase ?o0 ?o1)
      (next ?o1 ?o2)
    )

      (next ?o0 ?o2)
      (not (vase ?o0 ?o1))
    )
  )

      (texture ?o2)

      (next ?o1 ?o2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (vase ?o0 ?o1)
      (not (next ?o0 ?o2))
    )
  )

  (:action clip
    :parameters (?o0 - thing ?o1 - thing ?o2 - thing)
    :precondition (and
      (hand ?o0)
      (sneeze ?o1)
      (texture ?o2)
      (next ?o1 ?o2)
      (next ?o0 ?o2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (vase ?o0 ?o1)
      (not (next ?o0 ?o2))
    )
  )

  (:action wretched

      (texture ?o1)

      (collect ?o2 ?o3)

      (next ?o0 ?o2)
      (not (next ?o0 ?o1))
    )
  )

    )

      (vase ?o0 ?o1)
    )

      (not (vase ?o0 ?o1))
    )
  )
